Ida (CS): Heads-up — kickoff for slot allocation ceremony with HelioMint is now. Need a short checklist: quota reservation, autoscale policy, load test windows, and enablement session. cc @Marc @Devon @Julia
Marc (Eng): On it. I pulled their quota request: 120 reserved tokens/sec sustained, 300 burst for 5m. Is that still accurate from the contract?
Julia (AE): Yep, confirmed in the SOW. They want a 90-day ramp to full 120 sustained. Renewal signal flagged if we miss latency SLA for >3 days.
Devon (SRE): For autoscale, suggest policy "helio-burst-fallback-v2": base pool sized for 100 sustained, allow +50% burst headroom via ephemeral nodes. Will need approval for burst budget.
Ida (CS): Budget note: they asked for predictable billing. Can we map burst consumption to a separate metered bucket so it's visible in console?
Marc (Eng): Yes — we can tag burst instances and emit token-level cost metrics. Should be visible in Console > Per-route > HelioMint.
Sara (PM): Can we schedule a short enablement on Wed 11am PT to walk HelioMint engineers through priming and prefix caching? They specifically asked for best practices to reduce unit cost.
Ida (CS): Wed 11am works. I'll send calendar invite once we lock the load windows.
Devon (SRE): Proposing two load tests: 1) Warmup bake: 3h at 60% sustained to prime KV cache; 2) Surge probe: 30m spikes to 300 for circuit validation. Prefer Wed 2–6am PT for warmup to avoid interference.
Marc (Eng): Agree. I'll prepare a simple k6 script and a traffic profile. Draft snippet: ```k6 run --vus 120 --duration 180m --rps 300 ./scripts/heliomint_profile.js```
Ida (CS): Nice. Also capture success criteria: p95 latency < 220ms, no error rate >0.5%, and autoscale events should not trigger more than 4 cold-starts in the surge probe.
Julia (AE): Flagging renewal risk: if we see repeated latency SLO misses during first 30 days, we escalate to AM + offer a complimentary optimization sprint. Capture outcome in renewal playbook.
deploy-bot: deploy started for autoscale-policy "helio-burst-fallback-v2" on staging cluster at 2024-04-03T01:23:45Z
Devon (SRE): Deploy bot shows staging rollout ok. I'll run canary traffic and report back by EOD.
Marc (Eng): One more ask — instrument a short feedback form we can send after enablement: 3 questions (was priming helpful, did caching reduce cost, remaining blockers). I'll draft and Ida can send.
Ida (CS): Perfect. I'll also collect HelioMint's internal load profiles (token distributions, typical sequence lengths). Please drop them here before Tue EOD.
Sara (PM): I'll own the runbook note updates and include the exact autoscale thresholds plus rollback steps.
Ida (CS): Great team. Action items: Marc — k6 script and tagging instrumentation; Devon — schedule canary + run tests; Sara — runbook updates; Julia — confirm billing tag consent; Ida — invite + feedback form + collect profiles.
Marc (Eng): Copy. Starting work now.
Devon (SRE): Canary in progress. Initial p95 ~180ms on staging with prefix cache warm.
Ida (CS): Love it. If any blocker pops, escalate in this thread. Otherwise I'll send the enablement invite and load-test timeline tomorrow. :thumbsup:
